prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: BookStark Android Flutter redesign prototype board for pages 12 and 13. Create a polished high fidelity flat UI board on pale gray background, four tall Android screens side by side, no tilted devices, crisp readable simplified Chinese labels. Restrained white/slate theme with blue #315fca actions, generous spacing, touch targets, no stock photos. Screens:
1 章节目录: title 项目手册, search 搜索本书文档, hierarchical chapter cards with small type badges: 开始使用 Markdown; 数据预算 电子表格; 系统架构 画板; 学习路径 脑图; 团队说明 富文档; 产品介绍 演示文稿; 交互示例 HTML. Parent chapters remain selectable, menu dots and add chapter button. Bottom nav books selected.
2 文档阅读: breadcrumb 项目手册 / 开始使用, title 快速开始, small badge Markdown, clean native Markdown article with heading 准备你的工作空间, short text, code block, bottom selection toolbar 摘录到笔记, bottom previous 编辑 next. Small saved reading location 恢复到上次阅读位置.
3 电子表格: same native title and breadcrumb chrome, blue badge WebView, full existing spreadsheet web engine canvas showing realistic cells, row numbers and columns, worksheet tab 预算. No imitation native table editor. Top status 只读预览; bottom 明确进入编辑 button, 上一篇 下一篇 navigation. Separate subtle label 正文由现有网页引擎呈现. No save button before editor activation.
4 超大文档: breadcrumb 项目手册 / 附录, title 完整原文, clear badge 只读, message 内容超过编辑上限，全文完整保留. Bounded monospaced source chunk card with visible Markdown syntax, paragraph and emoji, section indicator 第 12 / 98 段, 上一段 下一段 controls, 跳转到段 action. Disabled 编辑 button with helper 当前内容不可编辑; selectable text/excerpt action 摘录当前段. Keep buttons reachable and layout responsive.
At bottom outside phones show small state-strip cards: 未知类型：保留原文，可分块查看，禁止保存; 格式无效：重试 / 查看原文，不生成空文档; 保存结果待核对：只读核对，禁止重放. Do not claim completed tests. All complex content uses embedded existing web engine. Markdown native. This is a designed prototype, not an acceptance screenshot.
status: design-only; not implementation or Native evidence
